name: jurisai
description: JurisAI — Resolve. Explain. Move on. Small Civil Dispute Resolution Platform

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "AI-SERVICE,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,green" "npm run start:ai" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
